entities.title: MCP over newline-delimited JSON-RPC
entities.summary: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message per line in, one reply per request line out; the server answers initialize, ping, tools/list (with no tools) and tools/call.
consumers: zazzled (macos/rust/zazzled/src/indexer.rs), which speaks these messages on a daemon connection to call view, overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame and report_gap by name
Whoever starts zazzle-csharp-indexer serve by hand, for debugging
entities.definition: initialize returns protocolVersion "2024-11-05", capabilities {tools: {}}, serverInfo {name: "zazzle-csharp-indexer", version: ToolVersion.Text} and instructions saying that the server offers no tools to agents and to use zazzle for everything, naming zazzle_read, zazzle_find, zazzle_edit and the structure tools (zazzle_overview, zazzle_find_symbol, zazzle_refs, zazzle_changed_since, zazzle_git_log, zazzle_git_blame, zazzle_report_gap). tools/list returns {tools: []}. tools/call {name, arguments} runs the internal tool of that name (src/Tools/.dev/operation.json) and returns {content: [{type: "text", text}], isError}.
guarantees: A message without an id is a notification and gets no reply; blank lines are skipped.
A line that is not JSON gets error -32700 with id null; a request without a method gets -32600; an unknown method gets -32601.
A tool's failure is not a JSON-RPC error: it is a result with isError true and the message as text; an unknown tool name is reported the same way.
Every tools/call, failed or not, writes one usage-log record (src/.dev/observability.json, usage-log).
entities.compatibility: Internal tool names and argument names are what zazzled relies on (macos/rust/zazzled/src/cmd/structure.rs and indexer.rs); renaming one breaks zazzle's structure tools until both are released together. Agents see only zazzle's names.
